name: Namor

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

howToPlay: Namor için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Hydrokinetic Armor
Namor takes [25 - 100]% reduced damage from all sources while attacking his Opponent. When Namor ends an Attack, any damage prevented by Hydrokinetic Armor is captured and sent back to the Opponent as Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Medium Attacks
content: 60% chance to inflict Bleed dealing [3,021.3] Direct Damage over 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Outrage
content: Namor can have a maximum of 30 Stacks of Outrage.

Every 3 seconds Namor gains 1 Outrage. Each time Namor is affected by a Stun Debuff, he reduces the time between each Outrage generated by 0.5 seconds. Once Namor activates IMPERIUS REX the timer is reset back to 3 seconds.
Namor generates 1 Outrage whenever he is affected by a Bleed or Incinerate Debuff.
Namor generates 1 Outrage whenever a Bleed or Stun Debuff fails to apply due to an Immunity or chance, or whenever the Opponent Purifies a Debuff.
Namor does not gain Outrage when failing to apply Bleed Debuffs to Robots. He does not hold them responsible for their lack of blood.

abilitySections.title: IMPERIUS REX
content: If Namor has 15 stacks of Outrage he can Dash Back and hold Block for 1.2 seconds to instantly gain 1 bar of Power and activate IMPERIUS REX.
If Namor has 30 stacks of Outrage he instantly generates up to 95% of his Max Power and activates IMPERIUS REX.
Namor's Special Attacks deal up to 240% additional damage based on active stacks of Outrage
Special Attacks cost 90% less Power. However, Namor Drains 15% of a bar of Power every second. Each Special Attack Namor launches applies an additional Drain of 5% per second.
While IMPERIUS REX is active, Namor cannot gain Power from any sources other than his own abilities.
Once Namor has 0 Power remaining, all stacks of Outrage are removed and IMPERIUS REX ends.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: While IMPERIUS REX is active, launching a Heavy Attack consumes 15 stacks of Outrage to generate 100% of a bar of Power.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Namor Regenerates 3% of his missing Health.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit has a 50% chance to inflict a Bleed dealing [10,071] Direct Damage over 8 seconds
While IMPERIUS REX is active, Namor generates twice as much Outrage from all sources for the duration of this Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Each hit has a 50% chance to inflict Stun lasting 2.5 seconds.
While IMPERIUS REX is active this attack is Unblockable.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Gain a Passive Fury increasing Attack Rating by [30,213] for 20 seconds. While this Fury is active, Namor's Opponents gain 0 Power when struck by Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Hydrokinetic Armor
content: Namor takes [25 - 100]% reduced damage from all sources while attacking his Opponent. When Namor ends an Attack, any damage prevented by Hydrokinetic Armor is captured and sent back to the Opponent as Energy Damage.
